Subject : Compliance Audit of Exempted/Relaxed Establishments - Regarding.
Sir,

Authority to secure compliance from the establishments covered and coverable under
the EPF & MP Act, 1952 and manage default lies with the Regional P.F. Commissioners of the
Regional Offices and Sub Regional Offices. Exempted/Relaxed Establishments are no exception
to this. In case of establishments who are enjoying exemption/relaxation and maintaining their
own Provident Fund Trusts, one of the mechanisms to secure compliance and ensure default
management is through compliance audit of the establishments and the Trusts.

A It has come to the notice that some of the field offices have not been conducting
Compliance Audit of the Exempted/Relaxed Establishments falling under their territorial
jurisdiction in anticipation of issuance of directions from the Head office in this regard. Here it
is pertinent to reiterate that securing compliance and default management in respect of all the
establishments including exempted/relaxed establishments, covered under the EPF & MP Act,
1952 lies within the original jurisdiction of Regional P.F. Commissioners of the field offices.
Hence, they need not wait for issuance of directions from the Head Office in this regard.

3, Henceforth compliance audit of exempted/relaxed establishments should be conducted
by the Field Offices regularly on annual basis. Proforma of the compliance audit report has
already been circulated to the offices vide Head Office circular No- C-Ex/Misc./Comp.
Audit/2009/3124-31391 dated 10.10.2011 and is available on the official website of EPFO at SI.
No. 342 under Office Orders/Circulars (2011-12) page.

Yours Faithfully,
